Title: Azure AD Application Proxy support for single sign-on to SAML-based applications.

Body.Content:
Connect custom or popular SAML-based on-premises line of business apps to Azure AD for single sign-on, without the need for VPN. Apps that are connected to Azure AD gain cloud-powered security, productivity, and scalability benefits for IT and end-users.

Learn more
